messages:
sasha: quick heads-up: compliance wants partner SIEM exports reduced from 30d -> 7d. This affects RBAC and KMS unwrap. blockers?
raj: is this compliance-driven or incident-driven?
emily: fine for IR but need a clear request/extension flow for active investigations.
security-engineer: compliance requested 7d to lower exposure. proposal: per-export TTL enforcement, ticket-based approval for any extension, and KMS unwrap via proxy that mints single-use tokens tied to the ticket.
raj: split RBAC: internal exports still allowed 30d, partner role limited to 7d. alert on >7d requests.
sasha: sketch role: siem.partner_exporter (max_ttl=7d, requires_ticket=true, allowed_destinations=[partner-s3]). siem.ops keeps 30d.
security-engineer: sample policy (pseudo):
```json
{
  "role": "siem.partner_exporter",
  "max_ttl": "7d",
  "requires": ["ticket_id","approver"],
  "actions": ["export:create","export:download"]
}
```
emily: kms-proxy must validate ticket+approver, mint one-time unwrap token scoped to destination label, token expires in 10m. audit event: kms_proxy.unwrap {ticket, requester, dest}.
raj: can we reuse existing kms-proxy from forensics? if so minor change to add dest-scoping.
security-engineer: yes reuseable; will add metrics for unwrap attempts and failed approvals.
oncall-bot: approval recorded: raj approved SEC-512 at 09:12 UTC :white_check_mark:
sasha: rollout checklist: 1) create IAM roles/policies in prod 2) exporter enforces per-export TTL + ticket validation 3) kms-proxy dest-scoping + single-use tokens 4) alerting for >max_ttl requests 5) update runbook (https://redwood.internal/runbooks/siem-exports) 6) QA in staging with partner-s3 test data
emily: add emergency extension step: require SEC-incident ticket, second approver (legal), and justification field logged.
raj: migration Q: do we delete existing partner exports >7d?
security-engineer: no retroactive deletion. new policy applies to new exports only; we'll inventory and notify partners.
sasha: I'll open RFC + PR with policy JSON and kms-proxy patch. target staging tomorrow, prod mid-week. ping when PR up.
